The survey What's changed

What's changed

This page lists the changes to Manhattan Community Mapping, the map survey BetaNYC built for the 2026 Manhattan Borough President convention, that a person filling it in would notice: new questions, changed wording, and fixes. Newest first. The survey's answers are collected privately and are not published on this site.

  • History begins: 2026-01-30, the day the survey first went online. Every change since then is listed.

To report a bug in this survey or ask for a new feature, open an issue on GitHub.

A What's changed page

Questions match the printed maps

February 20, 2026

Tags: Site

The wording of the questions now matches the printed maps used at the convention, and the kinds of map were renamed to match, for example "Parks & Open Space" instead of "Parks". The choices for what a pin marks are now buttons to pick one, instead of a drop-down list.

More detail: The commit

Link to this change: Questions match the printed maps

Housing added as a kind of map

February 19, 2026

Tags: Site

Housing is now one of the kinds of map, with two choices for a pin: "More new housing" and "Affordable housing preservation".
